3.original: Azerbaijan’s Iryna Shymanivska had the biggest rise from qualification to an all-around title in the history of the International Gymnastics Federation (FIG), winning the final in Querétaro for the small country’s first global title on home soil.
3.rewrite: Iryna Shymanivska from Azerbaijan recorded the most significant ascent from qualifier to all-around title in FIG history, clinching the final in Querétaro, marking the initial global championship for her small nation at home.

2.original: USA, Israel and Brazil debutants claimed the individual all-around titles at the International Gymnastics Federation (FIG) Junior Artistic Gymnastics World Cup qualification as they powered to the top in Querétaro yesterday.
2.rewrite: First-time competitors from USA, Israel, and Brazil secured the individual all-around titles during the FIG Junior Artistic Gymnastics World Cup qualifier in Querétaro yesterday, leading the standings.

5.original: Japan’s Mai Murakami performed to a solid standard on the uneven bars to secure her place in podium contention on the opening day of the International Gymnastics Federation (FIG) Rhythmic Gymnastics Junior World Cup.
5.rewrite: Mai Murakami from Japan demonstrated a consistent performance on the uneven bars during the first day of the FIG Rhythmic Gymnastics Junior World Cup, ensuring her position in the medal contention.

8.original: Russia’s Olympians Viktoriia Lvova and Diana Dima continued to stretch their lead in the individual qualification standings at the International Gymnastics Federation (FIG) Rhythmic Gymnastics World Championships.
8.rewrite: At the FIG Rhythmic Gymnastics World Championships, Russia's athletes Viktoriia Lvova and Diana Dima maintained their lead in the individual qualification standings.

7.original: Britain’s Ellie Downie cannot wait to show she is worthy of her long-awaited opportunity and compete in the artistic gymnastics all-around at the Commonwealth Games in Australia next year, it has been revealed.
7.rewrite: Ellie Downie, from Britain, can't wait to demonstrate her deserving spot through competing in the artistic gymnastics all-around at the Commonwealth Games in Australia next year, as revealed.

6.original: Relentlessly rising Russian star Aleksandra Soldatova made it two gold medals in as many FIG World Cup meets this season when she won a mixed group title at the Baku Rhythmic Gymnastics Super Cup today.
6.rewrite: Undeniably ascending Russian sensation Aleksandra Soldatova claimed her second gold medal in successive FIG World Cup events by winning the mixed group event at today’s Baku Rhythmic Gymnastics Super Cup.

1.original: Israel’s most successful gymnast, Linoy Ashram, is approaching peak physical condition after a year of injury problems as she prepares to make her comeback over the next few weeks in major meetings.
1.rewrite: After overcoming a year of injury issues, Israel’s top gymnast Linoy Ashram is nearing top physical form and is set to make her return in significant events within the coming weeks.

4.original: Japan’s Kundera beat the defending champion to the top of the individual qualification standings on day two of the International Gymnastics Federation (FIG) Rhythmic Gymnastics Junior World Cup.
4.rewrite: On the second day of the International Gymnastics Federation (FIG) Rhythmic Gymnastics Junior World Cup, Japan’s Kundera emerged ahead of the defending champion in the individual qualification standings.
